targets.review_note: Hungarian algorithm on negative weights produces optimal matching and feasible duals. Every alternate optimal matching uses only tight edges. Direct each nonmatched tight edge to the boy owning its girl; a matched edge is replaceable exactly when its boy belongs to an alternating cycle. Bitset transitive closure identifies cycles, yielding intersection of all optimal matchings in O(n^3).

targets.review_note: Parallel bases form an isosceles trapezoid iff their midpoints share the same perpendicular bisector and lie on different parallel lines. Normalize integer direction with gcd; group by direction and midpoint projection. Within each group keep maximum prior endpoint weight, combine only distinct line offsets. If current shares the best line, a second-best base was already combined when it arrived, so no lost optimum. Exact integer arithmetic, O(n^2) pairs.

targets.review_note: Dijkstra on (grid cell, remaining fuel). Each move consumes one unit; entering an existing station forces paid refill. At nonstations an optional refill costs setup+fuel. Left/up moves add B. Positive costs eliminate revisiting newly-built stations in optimal paths; arrival at destination needs no refill. Full initial tank, O(N^2 K log(N^2 K)).
